ModMetadata.Name: StationeersLua Addon Template [StationeersLaunchPad]
ModMetadata.Author: zedle
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]StationeersLua Addon Template[/h1] [i]Open-source sample LaunchPad mod:[/i] registers extra Lua VM bindings through [b]StationeersLua[/b]’s public LuaLibraryRegistry API (same extension point as ScriptedScreens). Fork this project to ship your own ic.* or global Lua helpers in C#.
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*] [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5.x[/url] [*] [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3659911735]StationeersLua[/url] — [b]required[/b]; load before this mod [/list]
[h2]Sample Lua[/h2] After load, chips can call ic.addon_template.hello(). Replace the registration code with your own API.
